_note: Do-not-retry registry (manually curated, same philosophy as tested_models.json but for hypotheses/levers rather than individual VLM candidates). Read this BEFORE starting a new experiment (see scripts/check_prior_art.py). Changing a verdict requires citing lesson/doc evidence for the new finding; do not flip a verdict on argument alone. `reopen_when` states the concrete condition under which the claim is eligible to be re-tested.

entries.claim: Prompt/schema redesign (the v9c–v18 lineage, including E1 v15/v18 identity-first schema separation) delivers a distribution-robust calorie-MAE win.
entries.reopen_when: A new prompt/schema variant shows a pooled (>=3-set) calorie-MAE win with consistent sign across all sets, not just a set-specific deflation (e.g. the N5k-only small-dish fix v18 produced).

entries.claim: The v14 weight-cap relaxation + scale-anchor prompt change improves calorie MAE in the realistic 200-1500kcal meal range.
entries.reopen_when: A portion-scaling change is evaluated specifically against the giant-plate (>1500kcal) tail where the slope effect was found, with a separate promotion gate for that segment.

entries.claim: gemini-3.1-pro-preview (or a larger/premium VLM in general) has a robust calorie or recognition edge over flash that justifies adoption.
entries.reopen_when: A new, independently verified ground truth (not a GPT-5-pro estimate) shows the candidate with a consistent-sign advantage across at least 2 independent eval sets.

entries.claim: A premium (paid) embedding model, reranker, or native VLM-side retrieval path cleanly beats the free open lightweight stack (0.6B embedding + 0.6B reranker) for USDA calorie estimation.
entries.reopen_when: A new premium provider slot is paired-tested and its CI does not cross 0 on a pooled multi-set rotation.

entries.claim: Available uncertainty signals (free output-based proxies or self-consistency dispersion) predict per-image calorie error well enough to drive E9 (ask-a-question-when-uncertain) or E18 (tiered routing) cheap-signal versions.
entries.reopen_when: A new uncertainty signal (e.g. cross-model disagreement rather than same-model sample variance) shows pooled AUC clearly above 0.5 with a CI that excludes 0.5 for error prediction.

entries.claim: Selective-E7 (routing single/dominant-item images to top-1 instead of the top-k density mixture) reduces the E7 hard-set p90 tail without hurting the mean.
entries.reopen_when: A different tail-detection heuristic (not single/dominant-item routing) is tested and shows p90 improvement without mean regression.

entries.claim: A single 50-image run is sufficient to promote or reject a small-effect, data-independent lever.
entries.reopen_when: Never for small-effect levers — pooled rotation across multiple sets is a standing Non-Negotiable (plans/current.md), not a per-lever finding that can be reopened.

entries.claim: A calorie calibration fit on global data or on weighed lab sets (NVReal+N5k) can be enabled in production for real (JFB-domain) user photos.
entries.reopen_when: E13 in-domain (mozu real-user, weighed) labeled data is collected and used to fit the conditional calibration; only an in-domain fit is eligible for production (lab/global fits are not).

entries.claim: A heterogeneous-model median ensemble (e.g. flash+grok+gpt) beats same-model SC K=3 median for calorie accuracy at a viable cost.
entries.reopen_when: A model with flash-equivalent accuracy and decorrelated (not merely independent) errors becomes available at reasonable cost/latency (per docs/MODEL_REFRESH_OS_20260611.md §3 reopen condition).

entries.claim: Scraped/styled recipe-photo datasets (e.g. oishi-kenko Scraping_Data, allrecipes.com) can substitute for E13 real-domain weighed calibration/eval data.
entries.reopen_when: Never as a calibration/eval substitute for E13 — usage stays scoped to recognition / density-prior / language-specific calorie sanity checks only (per DRIVE_DATASET_INVENTORY_20260607.md).

entries.claim: Any of the 17 next-generation candidates screened in model-refresh cycle 1 (2026-06-11: qwen3.5/3.6/3.7, grok-4.3/4.20, kimi-k2.6, haiku-4.5, sonnet-4.6, gpt-5.2/5.4-mini, seed-2.0, minimax-m3, ernie-4.5vl, step-3.7, nova-2, perceptron) beats flash on calorie accuracy within budget.
entries.reopen_when: The next scheduled model-refresh cycle (monthly or major-release trigger, per docs/MODEL_REFRESH_PROTOCOL_20260611.md) re-screens these or newer candidates against the current flash baseline.

entries.claim: Union-of-K self-consistency for recognition (merging items across K samples) is a clean recognition win: recall improves (+5.4pt) but wrong-food items triple (13->37, phantom items) and calorie accuracy worsens; recognition misses are bimodal (0/5 or 5/5) i.e. systematic, not sampling variance.
entries.reopen_when: A union variant is paired with an effective phantom-suppression mechanism, or a new domain shows recognition misses that are sampling-variance-driven (not bimodal/systematic).

entries.claim: A same-tier self-verification 2nd pass (flash verifying flash) improves recognition/conviction: the same-bias verifier rubber-stamps the first pass and net conviction stays flat (mechanism is implemented and works, opt-in, default OFF).
entries.reopen_when: A materially stronger or differently-biased verifier tier becomes affordable for the 2nd pass (relates to the frozen E18 tiered-routing design).

entries.claim: An embedding-based matcher for eval-side pred<->GT dish matching beats the token/char matcher: it loses badly (kappa 0.50 -> 0.12); the token/char matcher stays the eval-harness default.
entries.reopen_when: A new matcher variant is validated against golden-labeled matching data and reaches kappa at least equal to the token/char baseline (0.50).
